name: Justification By Faith Alone
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that justification is granted through faith alone, apart from the works of the law. Romans 3:28 and Galatians 2:16 emphasize that no one can be justified by law-keeping, but only through faith in Jesus Christ. This faith, as Romans 4:5 explains, is credited as righteousness even to the ungodly, and Romans 5:1 assures believers that through this justification by faith, they have peace with God through Jesus Christ.
